candidates.description: This feature vector represents the concept of pharmaceutical substances, particularly addictive drugs and medications.
This vector activates for words, stems, and translations related to the concept of utilization and usage.
This feature vector represents medical terminology related to healthcare, clinical treatments, and patient symptoms across different populations.
This vector represents a semantic concept of high intensity, severity, or sudden and forceful change.
This feature vector represents chemical prefixes, suffixes, and functional group terminology related to organic chemistry and biochemistry.
This vector represents quantifiers and indefinite adjectives across multiple languages indicating quantity or number.
This vector represents logical connectors and transition words used to indicate consequence, sequence, or contrast across multiple European languages.
this vector represents modal auxiliary verbs expressing possibility, permission, or obligation across multiple languages.
This vector represents common German inflected verb forms indicating action or state.
This feature vector represents words and roots related to creation, manufacturing, and the Latin root *producere*.
